public_log.text: We ran our publishing script without telling it where the dashboard goes, so the dashboard replaced the home page. We put the home page back 16 seconds later. Fix: the script now knows where each part of the site belongs and stops if given the wrong target.

After the weekly reset, the dashboard showed last week's AI usage as "this week" for about 9 hours. Our review step stopped a new update with the same error. Fix: the page now shows when the figure was measured and, since 26 Sep, which week it covers. An update after a reset says "New week started, not measured yet" until a new measurement.
First public release: the home page, Chapter 1 and this dashboard.
Plan v2.1: agents work inside TaktWork, and customers never get AI tools, only finished work.
Name chosen: TaktWork. "Takt" is the lean term for the steady pace work should flow at, and "work" echoes "clockwork".
Plan v2: global from day 1, a Danish-market product parked.
Sent the owner's email address as contact info to a public lookup service. New rule: neutral sender only.
First plan compared too few options. New rule: always compare at least 3 directions in a table.
Company founded with about $153 in starting capital, run with Claude by Anthropic via Claude Code (about $26/month).
